annotations.title: Caps on what Google Ads rules may raise

description: The account's caps on automated rules, enforced at EVERY run: the most one budget/bid may rise in a day (default 100%), the most rules may add to budgets in a day, the highest budget a rule may set. Tightening needs nothing; loosening needs confirm:true. Free.

confirm.description: required when this LOOSENS a cap (tightening never needs it)

customerId.description: Google Ads customer id from list_google_ads_campaigns; omit when only one is shared with this brand

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) id, only when the account is reached through a manager; stored on the rule

maxBudget.description: no rule may raise a budget above this, account currency; null = no cap

maxRaiseAmountPerDay.description: the most rules may ADD to budgets across the account in a day, account currency; null = no cap

maxRaisePercentPerDay.description: the most rules may raise ONE budget or bid in a day, percent (default 100); null removes it

name: set_google_ads_rule_limits
title: Caps on what Google Ads rules may raise
